scope: One explicitly selected existing owned Codex test thread and one new owned OpenCode free-model chat in one strict local collaboration room.
interpretation: The model-side command persisted a local submission without native API access. The owning worker validated and forwarded it to the exact peer session. A real model-origin linked reply returned to the same existing Codex thread while its network restriction stayed in force.
limitations: This is a same-machine cross-harness verification through an explicitly started test server. It does not establish two-machine connectivity or attachment to an active Codex desktop chat.
privacy: No native message bodies, project facts, chat IDs, private paths, credentials, socket identities or private markers are included.
